listen_port.description: Port the server listens on (e.g., 80 or 443).

listen_ipv6.description: Whether to also listen on IPv6.

server_name.description: Primary domain name for this server block.

root.description: Document root directory for the site.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL certificate file (only used if tls_enabled=true).

ssl_certificate_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (only used if tls_enabled=true).

ssl_protocols.description: Enabled TLS protocol versions (Mozilla Intermediate = TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; Modern = TLSv1.3).

ssl_ciphers.description: TLS 1.2 cipher suite (Mozilla Intermediate). Leave empty to let nginx/TLS 1.3 decide.

http2.description: Enable HTTP/2 on the TLS listener.

hsts.description: Send an HSTS header (Strict-Transport-Security) — only enable once HTTPS is verified.

redirect_to_https.description: If true, add an HTTP->HTTPS redirect server block.

upstreams.description: List of upstream definitions for proxy/load balancing.

proxy_pass.description: Target upstream or backend for proxy (e.g., 'http://app1').

extra_server_parameters.description: Additional raw directives for the server block (e.g., 'client_max_body_size 100m;').
